title: Best of Niagara Falls Tour
includes: Skip the line tickets for Journey Behind the Falls and the Boat
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Skip the Ticket Lines and Embark on Niagara’s #1 rated sightseeing tour, offering the ultimate adventure in the heart of Niagara Falls! Led by the region’s most passionate and entertaining guides, this fully guided, action-packed journey brings the Falls to life like never before. In just 4 thrilling hours, you’ll witness jaw-dropping views, feel the mist on your face, and uncover hidden gems and stories that most visitors miss. It’s not just a tour—it’s the most exciting way to experience the raw power, beauty, and magic of Niagara Falls!
